notes.title: 0.0.12b Update - New Map Tutorial, UI Refinement, and Gameplay Enhancements!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/LXZ5T1R.png

Greetings Survivors,

We're excited to roll out the v0.0.12b beta update for *End of Everything*! This update includes several visual and gameplay improvements designed to enhance your overall experience. Here’s what’s new in this version:

UI Refinement and Visual Enhancements:

Main Menu Overhaul: The main menu scene has been revamped with improved lighting, sky, weather effects, and time progression to showcase the game's detailed environment. We’ve also added a Latest News UI board to keep you updated with the latest information. Additionally, the UI layout has been restructured for better accessibility.
Player UI Refinement: The looted items overlay has been repositioned to the mid-lower center of the screen for convenience. We've also moved the vitals for HP/Thirst/Hunger and updated the HP icon.
Inventory UI Refinements: The crafting layout is now positioned on the right side of the inventory screen, while the holster/character section has been moved to the left.
Color Scheme and Fonts: We've updated the color scheme to match the horror elements, moving away from white text to something more fitting. More fonts have also been switched to the new style for consistency.
Splash Screen Fix: The Happy Dayz Games splash screen at the start of the game has been fixed.


Gameplay Changes:

New Items and Crafting Changes: The war grenade has been removed for the moment, and we've added a handcrafted wooden torch.
Fall Damage Adjustment: Fall damage has been adjusted, doubling the height from which you can fall before taking damage.
New Map Tutorial: A new map tutorial has been added to help new players grasp the game before stepping into the Lake map.
Fixed Axe and Storage: We've addressed issues with the axe and storage system.
Added Compass: A compass has been added for better navigation.
Zombie Adjustments: 

Zombie respawn/despawn timer has been fixed to 10 minutes (previously 3 minutes).
Fixed zombie wander time and range.
Altered zombie chase SFX.
Zombies now drop clothes, bones, and occasionally rare items.

Weather Effects: Weather effects, such as rain, now follow the player properly.


Bug Fixes:

Building Book UI: All issues with the Building Book UI have been resolved.


World and AI Improvements:

New Resource Nodes: Boulders and rock piles have been added as resource nodes, randomly spawned throughout the world, similar to how trees are generated.
AI Refinements: We've refined the enemy AI script to be less obscure, with improved pathing and fewer bugs. However, further testing is required on varying terrain elevations.


We’re committed to improving *End of Everything* and hope you enjoy these updates. Please continue to share your feedback and report any issues you encounter.

Thank you for being part of our journey!

Happy surviving,  
The Happy Dayz Games Team

notes.title: End of Everything v0.0.11b Beta Update - New Map & Enhancements!
notes.content:
Greetings Survivors,

We are thrilled to announce the release of the v0.0.11b beta update for End of Everything! This update introduces a brand new main map called Lake. Dive into an expansive environment featuring beautifully crafted paths, lush vegetation, detailed buildings, and serene water bodies. Here's what you can expect in this latest update:

New Content:

New Main Map: Lake - Explore paths, vegetation, buildings, and water features in our newest map.

https://i.imgur.com/5GxcKJ9.png

Visual Enhancements:

Adjusted darkness levels for a more immersive night experience.
Morning sunlight rays have been fine-tuned for better visuals.
Extended day and night cycles to enhance realism and gameplay experience.


User Interface and Settings:

Reduced font size in the game menu for better readability.
Added resolution/apply options directly in the in-game menu for easy access.
Added possible mouse sensitivity settings for better control.


Fixes and Optimizations:

Various UI and font fixes for a smoother interface.
Reduced the game download size to 3.5GB from over 5GB.
Adjusted day-night cycle ratios to 1.2 for day and 0.8 for night, with a total cycle duration of 45 minutes.


We hope these changes will enhance your gameplay experience. As always, your feedback is invaluable to us, so please keep it coming!

Thank you for your continued support!

Happy surviving,

The Happy Dayz Games Team
